name: autoria-mcp
description: AUTO.RIA (automotive): get_listing, get_valuation. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_autoria_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AUTORIA_API_KEY
platform_mcp_autoria_api_key.description: Personal API key from the developers.ria.com cabinet (Особистий кабінет); sent as the api_key query parameter. auto/info is freemium, statistic-avarage-price is paid.

platform_mcp_autoria_user_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AUTORIA_USER_ID
platform_mcp_autoria_user_id.description: Your RIA user id (integer); required by get_valuation (auto/statistic-avarage-price takes user_id and api_key in the query).

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: GET https://developers.ria.com/auto/info?api_key&auto_id=<ad id> (freemium). price is the USD price (UAH and EUR are in raw); autoData holds year, race (mileage text), fuelName, gearboxName; stateData.regionName, photoData, seoLinkM and the VIN (only if the seller made it public) stay in raw. The seller's phone is always masked.

tools.name: get_valuation
tools.description: PAID. POST https://developers.ria.com/auto/statistic-avarage-price/?user_id&api_key {langId: 4, period: 365, params: {omniId: <VIN>}} — search by unique identifier ('available only if the car was advertised on the site'). Pass `vin` (a state plate or AUTO.RIA ad id also work as omniId). Returns a price history, not a band: raw.graphData[] = {date: 'YYYY-MM', price: {UAH, USD}} over the last 365 days; low/mid/high stay null.
